lines.text: Let's make sure we're on the same page.

data.define: Used when people share the same understanding.

example.text: Let's make sure we're on the same page.

misuse.text: Don't say 'on the same page' about a paperback.
misuse.why: It means shared understanding, not books.

publish.title: What does "on the same page" mean?
publish.value: On the same page = We understand each other. Example: "Let's make sure we're on the same page." (casual English).
